package.description: Offline resume builder with 25 templates, live PDF preview and ATS keyword analysis.

en-US.description: Offline resume builder with 25 templates, live PDF preview and ATS keyword analysis.
en-US.longDescription:
A free cross-platform desktop resume and cover-letter builder with live PDF preview,
25 resume templates and 3 letter templates. Export PDF, DOCX, HTML, PNG, plain text
and JSON Resume. Import local Word, PDF, JSON and LinkedIn export files.

Core editing, export, application tracking, backups and keyword matching work locally
without an account or AI key. Workspace data stays on this computer unless you enable
folder sync or choose a cloud AI provider. Cloud AI sends the relevant text to that
provider; a configured local model keeps AI processing on this machine.

Exports are free. There are no subscriptions or account requirements.
en-US.name: Resume Builder
